Rachel_1: daughter of Laban (Genesis 29:10) and wife of Jacob (Genesis 29:28)
Leah_1: daughter of Laban (Genesis 29:16) and wife of Jacob (Genesis 29:23)
Judah_1: fourth-born son of Jacob (Genesis 29:35), son of Leah
Tamar_1: wife of Er (Genesis 38:6), and mother of Perez (Genesis 38:29) and Zerah (Genesis 38:30) by Judah
Hezron_2: son of Perez and grandson of Judah (Genesis 46:12)
Nahshon_1: son of Amminadab and brother of Elisheba (Exodus 6:23), head of the tribe of Judah during the census (Numbers 1:7)
Naomi_1: wife of Elimelech (Ruth 1:2) and mother-in-law of Ruth (Ruth 1:4)
Mahlon_1: son of Elimelech (Ruth 1:2) and husband of Ruth (Ruth 4:10)
Boaz_1: kinsman of Naomi's husband (Ruth 2:1) who redeemed Ruth (Ruth 4:10)
Obed_1: son of Ruth and father of Jesse (Ruth 4:17)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Ram_1: son of Hezron in the lineage of King David (Ruth 4:19)
Salmon_1: son of Nahshon and father of Boaz in the lineage of King David (Ruth 4:19)
